evidence.source: PLOS 官方论文正文 HTML
evidence.checked_scope: Methods: Experimental data; Table 2 caption; Cluster-number recovery; Supporting information listing.

evidence.finding: Experimental data 方法逐项列明论文报告的数据集；另述 Tabula Muris cluster-number recovery。主文检索 Nestorowa 与 GSE81682 均无匹配。所列分析名中没有明确的 Nestorowa/HSC 名称。
evidence.interpretation_limit: 这只说明当前可读主文未将 Nestorowa/GSE81682 列为所述分析数据。正文指向一个含额外比较、分析和 benchmark 的 S1 Appendix；附件正文未核，故不能据此声称整篇文章绝未用该数据。
evidence.additional_main_text_analysis: Tabula Muris cluster-number recovery: 15,771 genes x 39,207 cells; 38 cell types from 18 tissues; subsequent sampled/equalized analyses described at lines 478-481.
